scope: Archived actual R4 training logs, scalar fields only; no training text or weights.

digits.loss_definition: Sum target CE weights (5 on actual changed target spans, 1 elsewhere) / valid target tokens, plus 0.1 × mean relu(0.5 − (correct−wrong) focal normalized conditional logP). Each wrong branch uses its own decoder prefix under the same source. Both pair directions trained. Conversations use plain CE. Pure insertion/deletion uses an adjacent common token only for the missing margin-score side, never for CE5x; anchor counts are recorded separately.
